_comment: Intake schema + selection rubrics for campaign-brief-generator. This is a pure-reasoning composite: the AGENT does all synthesis. Use this to run one grouped intake pass (don't make it feel like a form) and to ground the channel/messaging/content decisions.

required_inputs.goal: success definition with a number + timeline
required_inputs.icp: title/company/stage/geo + current pain + channels they use
required_inputs.product: what's promoted, core value prop, social proof, anti-positioning

channel_selection.rule: Recommend 2-4 channels for seed/Series A; resist >4 (execution quality beats breadth).

options.linkedin-organic: best for B2B founders/operators; low cost; needs consistent posting
options.x-organic: best for dev/technical + build-in-public; low cost
options.cold-email: best for defined ICP lists; medium effort; deliverability risk
options.content-seo: best for durable demand; high effort; slow payoff
options.community: best for niche ICPs (Slack/Discord/Reddit); medium effort
options.paid-social: best for fast tests with budget; needs creative + budget
options.webinar-event: best for high-ACV / education-heavy; high effort
options.partnerships: best for shared-ICP leverage; medium effort; relationship-gated

messaging_architecture.rule: One primary message + two secondaries; each with evidence + channel fit.

content_plan.rule: Concrete pieces with WORKING TITLES (not 'write some posts'), mapped week-by-week with owners + goals.

success_metrics.rule: KPI table by funnel phase (awareness -> engagement -> conversion) + ONE north-star metric.
